description: Approve on a phone: the Equipment Manager's queue (requests to decide, approved lines with no unit yet), most urgent first, as cards (the last 3 days, or every date) with chips and search (every date); a request in words (its lines, what each costs, free stock, availability); approve it or the lines chosen, or send back with a reason, in a bottom sheet that says what will happen; assign the suggested units in one tap or pick another unit for a line; then what is next up. The rules and calls are Next's Approve & allocate's (resources/js/approvalQueue.js, approveAllocate.js); the phone's logic is resources/js/mobileApprove.js.

canAct.description: FULL access: approve, send back, assign units.

saved.description: When the queue shown is this phone's copy (no connection): when it was saved, in words. Nothing can be decided then.

all.description: The queue as cards (mobileApprove.cards), most urgent first, of every date.

shown.description: The cards of the period under the chip, matching the search (which looks through every date).

period.description: recent (the last few days: mobileRecent) | all. A search looks through every date.

dated.description: The period shown (mobileRecent.dated): applied or set aside for a search, the older requests it leaves out under the chip, how many it keeps.

view.description: list | detail | done (what a decision did, and what is next up)

current.description: The card of the request open.

position.description: Where the open request is in the list shown: 2 of 5.

rec.description: The open request read in full (recordChain): its head, its lines in words, the one sentence on where it stands.

lines.description: The open request's lines (approveAllocate.loadLines): what the writes act on.

ticks.description: Lines chosen, in the order chosen: a decision acts on these, or on every line.

sheet.description: The bottom sheet open: approve | reject | assign | unit.

decision.description: What the decision sheet will do (mobileApprove.decideSheet).

result.description: What the last step did on this request, in words, when it stays open: { tone, text, items }.

sugg.description: The suggested units of each line still needing some (suggestChain), and what assigning them all will do.

picker.description: The line in the unit sheet (the picker itself is kept in the page module).

settled.description: Requests read with nothing left to assign: { key: lines taking no unit }. They leave the queue.

done.description: After a decision: what happened, the same request if it still waits, and what is next up (mobileApprove.done).

cleared.description: Decisions and units saved since the app opened.

focusRequest.description: Another tab, or a deep link, asked to show a request here (mobileBus.focus).
